streaming service = a website or app that shows films and series for a fee
playlist = a list of songs you choose to play
hit = a very popular song
album = a collection of songs released together
music single = one song released on its own
band = a group of people who play music together
lead singer = the main singer in a band
guitarist = a person who plays the guitar
drummer = a person who plays the drums
composer = a person who writes music
conductor = the person who leads an orchestra
choir = a group of people who sing together
tune = a series of musical notes that you can remember
beat = the regular pulse of a piece of music
lyrics sheet = a printed copy of the words of a song
pop music = popular music with a strong beat, often for young people
rock music = loud music with guitars and drums
folk music = traditional music of a country or region
jazz = a style of music with improvisation, often with saxophones
hip-hop = a style of music with rap and a strong beat
